Summary

This change adds typed reviewer policies, fresh GitHub identity and membership checks, authenticated feedback ingestion, approval gates, and durable CodeRabbit review-request controls. It matters because it allows trusted reviewer feedback to enter remediation while untrusted or unclassified feedback can block clearance. The reviewer must confirm that the required checks passed on the current head before deciding whether to merge. **Verdict: NEEDS_EVIDENCE** — do not merge yet. The available evidence does not show completed CI checks for the current head, `a81077ff50cd3705561bd49c4262879081b40f7c`. - **Blocking:** Provide completed results for each required CI check on the current head. - **Risks that need a decision before merge:** None established from the available evidence. - **Evidence that would close them:** The expected CI provider’s check names, completed statuses, and revision, showing the checks ran on `a81077ff50cd3705561bd49c4262879081b40f7c`. - **Anything the diff cannot show:** The author-reported test results are not independently verified execution evidence. The diff also does not establish live GitHub identity or membership responses, provider-side reviewer configuration, or runtime and scheduled-job behavior. The PR adds configurable trusted-review policies and evaluates GitHub review evidence in readiness and workflow decisions. It persists reviewer observations, exposes policy and evidence in operator views, bounds remediation payloads, and applies configured settings to CodeRabbit review requests and retry scheduling. **Changes: Trusted reviewer feedback** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Reviewer policy and trust**

The example configuration adds a disabled Codex reviewer entry.| |**GitHub evidence and readiness**
`src/github-reviewers.ts`, `src/github.ts`, `test/readiness-cli.test.ts`|Normalizes GitHub review and comment evidence, filters it using reviewer trust, and returns findings, approvals, acknowledgments, and blockers from readiness.| |**Workflow decisions and remediation**

Request reset times are not capped at 24 hours; unrepresentable provider hints are surfaced. Observation retry hints remain bounded.| |**Configuration and documentation**

The README documents reviewer configuration, evidence handling, policy adoption, review modes, and provider reset handling.| **Possibly related PRs** - [pstonesudol/adlc-bridge#10](https://github.com/pstonesudol/adlc-bridge/pull/10): Adds review-comment types and feedback handling that connect to this PR’s review evidence and feedback deduplication. - [pstonesudol/adlc-bridge#27](https://github.com/pstonesudol/adlc-bridge/pull/27): Introduces bounded provider retry handling and shared cooldown behavior used by this PR’s retry changes and recovery-observation coverage.
**Change:** Feature
Merge Risk: Moderate · previous review a8107

If CodeRabbit returns a rate-limit response whose reset time cannot be represented, other pull requests can still send review requests before an operator inspects it. This can worsen provider throttling. Add a provider-wide inspection hold before merging.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "feat(review): trusted bot and human reviewer policies (DEV-90)" matches the main change. The changeset adds reviewer configuration, trust and membership checks, feedback eligibility and approval rules, and CodeRabbit request-mode constraints, so the title names the primary feature. It uses conventional-commit style and a ticket reference, and it is specific enough for a teammate scanning history.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description is closely related to the changeset. It states the PR implements DEV-90 with typed reviewer configuration, pinned Codex/CodeRabbit bot identities, paginated collaborator and team verification, bound effective policy, CodeRabbit request mode, cooldown and retry constraints, and documentation of defaults and filters. These points match the file summaries for reviewer-policy.ts, github-reviewers.ts, coderabbit-scheduling.ts, review-loop.ts, and README.md. It also gives verification details and risks. The description contains extensive worker-reported API evidence that the author flags as unverified. That caveat does not affect this check, which only tests topical relevance.
Full details: Verification Evidence

**Explanation** The prior failure remains unresolved. The description marks the live GitHub API discovery transcript as unverified, but does not provide attributable execution logs. It reports unit-test results for head `a81077f`, but the supplied CI logs are for an earlier head. The head workflow runs `bun test`; fixtures do not confirm the API calls. This review cannot retrieve current provider logs. **Resolution** Provide attributable logs for the reported GitHub API discovery calls and current-head test execution, or current-head CI evidence for the tests. Keep fixture results separate from live provider evidence.
